gate_contract.claim: the node's wall is the union's exact distance wherever a field the step reads is not flat: judged without the node's own selection, on every face whose plain minimum lies between -1.5 and 3.5 cells, the node's indicator and resistivity are those of the union's exact distance (every candidate at every face) within 1e-6 of their own scale and its distance within 1e-9 cells where either reading's fields are not flat; its counts are zero; the wall its chunk makes once (the run-constant) is the step's own bit for bit

prediction.unit: cells (the distance); the indicator and the resistivity at the same order of their scales
prediction.why: the node's chosen faces run the same candidates as the exact union's, in another batch: what differs is the rounding of one distance read two ways; the run-constant is the same function of the same leaves

gate_contract.metric: the largest field difference where a field is not flat, the fields being what the step reads

control.plant: MIME_PLANT_WALL=minimum: the plain minimum everywhere (a carina's false wall about a cell too shallow); MIME_PLANT_WALL=floor: the candidates chosen only above half the band's fluid half (faces between half a cell and a cell into the fluid read the minimum, the review's half-band mutant transposed to this code)
control.resolution: discriminating_range.py on the distance (an error added at the worst non-flat face): predicted at the line, 1e-9 cells

gate_contract.if_wrong: a clean draw over the line names the face (its minimum, the union's and the node's depth in cells); the selection's floor or size is then wrong, and the fix is to choose more
gate_contract.cannot_discriminate_if: no face where the minimum and the union differ lies within the judged band (the loop's carina and roots always put some there; the minimum plant's own rate shows it)

gate_tie.claim: at an exact tie of two tubes' distances (two capsules sharing a ball, read beyond it) the union's derivative in a radius is one operand's (-1 or 0), never their average, and reverse mode equals forward mode: the guard of FA8's first fix whatever XLA's fusion does

prediction.why: the least is selected by one comparison (_lesser, _least), whose derivative is the selected operand's

gate_tie.metric: each tied point's derivative against the nearer of -1 and 0

control.plant: MIME_PLANT_UNION=reduction: jnp.min and jnp.minimum put back; their derivative averages tied operands, -0.5 at every tied point
control.resolution: a tied point's derivative half a unit off: the line 1e-9 is far below it

gate_tie.if_wrong: a clean draw off one operand's means a selection averages: the site is found and written by one comparison
gate_tie.cannot_discriminate_if: fewer than eight points beyond both tubes' ends (asserted against)

gate_reverse.claim: reverse mode equals forward mode through the node's own wall (every face, the candidates chosen in the program) at CI's seed: the guard of reverse against forward, not of the tie rule (gate_tie's)

prediction.why: 0 at CI's draw on the held faces; the wall on every face runs the same selections

gate_reverse.metric: relative difference of the directional derivatives in the first daughter's radii

control.plant: MIME_PLANT_UNION=reverse-scaled: the selection's reverse derivative 1 % larger

gate_reverse.if_wrong: a clean draw off means a selection is computed twice; it is found as the first fix found jnp.min
gate_reverse.cannot_discriminate_if: no chosen face (the plan size printed is zero)

gate_walk.claim: the tube tree's program is one under the two-builds walk: the radii and the period's length moved by a relative 1e-6 keep it (tree_flow in the walk, no list line), because the wall is made in the program and only its plan's size, a rung, is held at build

prediction.why: no array or literal of the step is made from a leaf at build: the selection and the reaches are traced, the rung moves only when the chosen count crosses it (about 1.4x apart)

gate_walk.metric: the trace form's comparison of the two builds' programs

control.plant: the plan's size made the build's own count (plan_rung the identity): the moved leaves' builds differ in a shape
control.resolution: a move that changes the chosen count by one face

gate_walk.if_wrong: a fire names the array or literal; it is made in the program, or held as a declared count
gate_walk.cannot_discriminate_if: the moved leaf changes no chosen face (then the control is quiet too, and the walk is not evidence for that leaf)

control.plant: MIME_PLANT_WALL=daughter in float32 alone (the first daughter a quarter cell out): the split moves about 0.02

gate_float32.if_wrong: a float32 split off float64 past the line means a guard is missing: its operating point is read (a CG's floor, the union's allowances)
